about: The mount over a real Cloudflare quick tunnel (companion/tests/live_tunnel.py), and the same script with no tunnel as a baseline. Both in the mirror mode: the Mac has no FUSE. Seconds unless named.

tunnel.where: MacBook Air, macOS, Python 3.14, Wi-Fi; both ends on the one Mac, so every byte went out to Cloudflare and back in
tunnel.note: rtt_ms was not measured by that version of the script (the mirror reads nothing on demand); the probe that measures it came after.

local.where: the Linux container the feature was built in, Python 3.14; 127.0.0.1, no tunnel; median of 3 runs
